board.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a NEW 2 by 2 contact sheet of FOUR equal square photographic frames for La Bonne Séance: four consecutive stages of one inverted bodyweight row using TWO FREESTANDING PARALLEL DIP BARS, not a single crossbar. Do not copy the defects of the reference. Reference image is only the exercise intent. New visual style: warm 1990s printed exercise photograph, cream #F4EEE4 plaster wall, warm wood floor, dark ink green #012F2B mat and bars, subtle orange #E98A15 accent in distant background, restrained fixed-looking fine paper grain. Natural ordinary athletic adult woman, dark green T-shirt, plum #59114D leggings, flat trainers, tied hair. No exaggerated muscles, logos, labels or numbers.
Critical set geometry: two identical rigid metal inverted-U dip stands, shoulder-width apart, long top handles parallel to the woman's head-to-feet direction. Each has two vertical uprights and broad transverse rubber feet. Entire stands remain visible and fixed, no changing tube lengths or extra crossbars. Her body lies face-up BETWEEN the two stands; her head is toward image right and straight legs extend toward image left. One closed hand grips EACH stand's top handle at exactly the SAME fixed world position in all four frames, palms facing one another, thumbs wrapped. Both hands and both elbows clearly visible. Both HEELS touch the SAME spots on the mat in every frame. Shoes never slide. Camera tripod fixed at a low side three-quarter angle looking slightly down to separate both stands and both arms. All four frames identical scale, lens, crop, equipment, background, heel position and hand position. 8% clear margin around all feet, head, bars and shoes.
Frame1: low hanging position, elbows extended, torso and straight legs form one straight sloping line from head through hips to heels; hips visibly clear of the mat, neck aligned.
Frame2: first third of pull, both elbows begin bending, shoulders/chest/hips rise together as a rigid straight line pivoting at the heels, elbows go toward the sides of torso.
Frame3: two thirds of pull, both elbows more bent, chest approaches hand height, body still straight, hands and heels unmoved.
Frame4: top of row, chest close to handle height, elbows bent alongside torso, no shrugging or neck thrown back, hips stay on shoulder-to-heel line. Hands stay gripping the exact same spots. Show anatomical continuity, equal limb lengths, physically plausible connected shoulders/elbows/wrists. No stand passing through body, no detached wrist, no duplicate limbs. Thin equal cream gutters between frames. Output one contact sheet; this is a candidate for human review, prioritize clear mechanics over decorative texture.
board.selection: Only top-left cell retained; remaining cells rejected for equipment/foot drift

top.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact image into the TOP position of the SAME inverted row. Return ONE square photo, not a grid. Preserve the camera, background, green mat, every metal bar and base foot, both hand contact positions and both heel contact positions EXACTLY. Do not zoom, recrop or move the equipment. Keep the exact same woman, outfit and limb proportions. ONLY move her body into the completed pull: bend BOTH elbows to roughly a right angle, elbows point down/back alongside torso, chest rises close to top handle height. Body stays one straight line from shoulders through hips to the heels, rotating around fixed heels. Head rises with torso, neutral neck. Hands NEVER slide and stay fully wrapped around existing handles at original pixels; two visible connected wrists and forearms. Lift shoulders and hips together, do not just crane neck or bend hips. No bar passes through body. Preserve both rail silhouettes. Fine warm retro photograph grain, no new decoration. Anatomical dimensions constant. This is one endpoint still for visual review.
